success.title: Payment Successful
success.description: Your payment has been processed successfully. A confirmation email will be sent to you shortly.

fail.title: Payment Failed
fail.description: Something went wrong while processing your payment. Please try again or use a different payment method.

cancel.title: Payment Cancelled
cancel.description: You have cancelled the payment. No charges have been made to your account.

error.title: Something Went Wrong
error.description: We couldn't verify your payment status. Please contact support if the issue persists.
